Account background: mid-market analytics SaaS. Core product: in-app search and assistant for product teams (help center + contextual quick answers). Currently on another LLM API provider (contracted, multi-region). Evaluating Redwood as migration path: start hosted for fast parity check, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost.

Technical preferences / asks: compat-layer / openai-shim so minimal SDK changes; identical tokenization/embedding vectors for rerank parity; migration guide for prompt collisions and stop-token behavior. POC scope: 1) run smoke on hosted API (parity check) using their 300 prompt goldset; 2) perf validation on a 2-week dedicated trial (200 req/s sustained, spike to 600 for bursts); 3) compare embeddings drift and re-index strategy.

Commercial: price sensitivity moderate — willing to commit to annual dedicated if 30-40% unit cost reduction vs current provider and committed latency SLOs. Finance asked for a sample TCO sheet.

Internal champions: Head of Product (Emily Rosario) pushing for lower per-token spend; Platform Eng (Diego Ramos) owns infra evaluation. Blocker: Legal wants a clearer data-handling annex.

Recent interactions summary: see timeline.
